Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[Senator Mon Mothma (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Agenda: rebellion. Deploys -1 aboard your capital starship. Once per turn, while in a senate majority (or Stolen Data Tapes on table), may take your just drawn battle destiny into hand. Once per game, may deploy Chandrila from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/december2019errata.pdf#page=2 december2019errata.pdf], page 2 (PDF dated 6 December 2019). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
